title: A Cosmic Alarm That Set Telescopes Racing

sentences: On 6 October 2026, Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for contributions to IceCube and the discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.
IceCube uses a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice to detect traces left by elusive particles from space.
On 22 September 2017, IceCube recorded the track of a particle produced by a high-energy neutrino.
An automated alert went out just 43 seconds later.
Observatories followed the direction in the alert.
NASA’s Fermi telescope identified a flaring galaxy in that direction, and MAGIC detected very-high-energy gamma rays from it.
The galaxy, TXS 0506+056, contains a supermassive black hole whose jet points towards Earth.
Together, the observations linked the neutrino to activity in a galaxy billions of light-years away.
A tiny trace in Antarctic ice had started an international search across the sky.
This was evidence connecting a cosmic neutrino to a distant source, rather than the first discovery of neutrinos themselves.

steps.say: 二〇二六年公布的诺贝尔物理学奖，颁给了推动南极冰立方观测站的科学家。它追踪的是几乎可以穿透地球的中微子。
二〇一七年九月二十二日，冰立方捕捉到高能中微子留下的踪迹，四十三秒后就向全球发出了警报。
望远镜随即接力追踪。费米太空望远镜找到了同方向正在爆发的星系，地面望远镜随后也观测到了它的高能伽马射线。
steps.note: MAGIC：位于加那利群岛的伽马射线望远镜

steps.say: 线索共同指向那座星系中心的超大质量黑洞，它喷出的高速物质正朝着地球。
我们把到达南极的微小粒子，和几十亿光年外的剧烈活动联系起来。宇宙送来线索，人类用地球和太空中的观测站追到了它的来处。
